description: This file defines the Git::SVN::GlobSpec class, which parses glob patterns for file path matching. It provides methods for initializing glob pattern objects and constructing full paths based on glob components.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A class for representing and processing glob patterns in file paths, supporting pattern matching and path construction.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that parses a glob pattern string into components and compiles matching regexes.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Constructs a full file path from the glob pattern components and a relative path.
